new_statement: Finally, exact right unitality and bilinearity give u-u bold-dot h=u bold-dot(J-h). Hence the product-norm axiom, ||u||<=2, and ||h-J||<=41*e yield ||u_delta(X)-X||<=82*(1+e)*e. Since 0<=e<=1/64, 82*(1+e)<=82*65/64=2665/32<84, and therefore ||u_delta(X)-X||<=84*e (including e=0).
